status: Public-source triage; two additional identity/action candidates verified; canonical inputs unchanged
scope: Determine whether more data can be gathered autonomously; not a completed historical strategy replay

inventory.important_caveat: Rows repeat across snapshots. 342 rows do not mean 342 missing companies. Candidate mappings and automated flags are not all confirmed data errors.

publicly_repairable_examples.vendor_problem: Vendor issuer name says Altair Engineering; CIK belongs to Altera. One post-redemption quote is present on 2017-11-01 at USD 18.31. Other vendor ALTR ID tts-827511 starts in 2017 and is a different issuer.
publicly_repairable_examples.proposed_repair: Map pre-merger vendor series to Altera using matching SEC CIK; quarantine 2017 observation; process mandatory cash redemption on 2015-12-28.
publicly_repairable_examples.remaining_validation: Check raw price units and historical dividend treatment independently, establish settlement timing assumption, and apply Irish CGT in the tax engine. This evidence does not certify every daily quote.

publicly_repairable_examples.vendor_problem: Vendor issuer name says aTyr Pharma; matching CIK and dates identify Life Technologies. The newer LIFE vendor ID tts-387639951 starts in 2026 and is Ethos Technologies.
publicly_repairable_examples.proposed_repair: Map vendor series to Life Technologies using matching SEC CIK and implement exact cash consideration, rather than the initial announcement amount of USD 76.
publicly_repairable_examples.remaining_validation: Check raw price units independently and establish settlement timing assumption. Irish CGT applies in the tax engine; no successor TMO shares should be created.

can_gather_without_user: SEC issuer filings and company announcements for cash merger terms, split ratios, spin-offs and security identities.
Additional public issuer holdings and dated Nasdaq announcements, subject to genuine historical coverage and publication timestamps.
Public vendor daily histories for delisted and successor securities, checked for split and spin-off adjustment conventions.
Evidence should be used to repair historical event accounting; future merger knowledge must not influence earlier trading decisions.
needs_more_work_or_licensed_data: Complete point-in-time weights, especially before 2014 and missing January-June 2017 snapshots; a later snapshot must not be backfilled into earlier decisions.
Complete daily prices, distributions and linked corporate actions for delisted names and retained successors; open sources contain identity and adjustment defects.
Irish treatment and cost-basis allocation for non-cash and mixed corporate actions; a US issuer Form 8937 alone does not establish Irish tax treatment.
Historical broker eligibility, fraction handling and spreads may be unavailable and should be disclosed assumptions rather than claimed Trading 212 observations.
what_user_can_optionally_supply: Existing licensed point-in-time Nasdaq-100 constituent/weight exports with effective and publication dates.
Unadjusted daily price and cash-dividend exports for delisted and successor securities, including stable identifiers and corporate-action tables.
Only lawfully available exports or read access; no new brokerage credentials or payment are needed for the public-source work.
